name: Katima Aigias
source:
A princess of the fallen kingdom "Aigers", who wishes to restore her kingdom and is leading rebel soldiers in "Sword World". Katima has a very strong sense of justice, and does not tolerate any evildoing. Because she upholds chivalry, she is very straightforward and dislike using any cowardly acts.

Katima completely adores Nozomi's Divine Beast, Monobe.
